newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears ADM/Acatos & Hutcheson buy of Soya Mainz.
newsitem.headline: EU clears ADM/Acatos & Hutcheson buy of Soya Mainz.

text.p: The European Commission has cleared the acquisition by Acatos & Hutcheson Plc and a subsidiary of ADM International Ltd of German soybeans processor Soya Mainz GmbH, a Commission source said on Tuesday.
The source did not give any details. The Commission is expected to make an official statement in the coming days.
Soya Mainz announced in June it had been sold to Archer-Daniels-Midland's ADM Beteiligungsgesellschaft mbH and Acatos, a British company active in the bottling and canning of vegetable oils.
The German company was previously owned by the Wilh. Werhahn group and Heidelberger Zement AG.
The sale was filed for EU regulatory approval on July 8.
ADM already has a controlling stake in leading German processor Oelmuehle Hamburg AG, which in 1996 crushed 3.10 million tonnes of soybeans.
